Rows = three normalisations {xi*r_s/R (field equation), sigma_from_potential(R,M)=xi*GM/Rc^2 (inventory), r_s/2R (docstring)} x two bodies {Earth, Sun} x two interpretations {'extra dilation on top of GR', 'e^sigma IS the GR factor (notation)'}.

metric_per_interpretation_as_read_before.extra_dilation: |e^sigma - 1| / z_GR, with e^sigma - 1 = sigma_time_dilation(sigma,1) - 1 and z_GR = 1/time_dilation_gr(M,R) - 1
metric_per_interpretation_as_read_before.notation: |e^sigma - 1/time_dilation_gr(M,R)| / z_GR  (the design's formula |e^sigma-1|/z_GR cannot be applied literally to this interpretation; this is its only coherent reading - declared here before the run)

prediction: Both 'extra dilation' rows that carry xi (field equation, inventory) excluded by >= 3 orders (ratios ~0.316 and ~0.158 vs 1.4e-4); only the 'notation' reading survives, which the code does not implement (two functions, two laws).
